notes: Every row is computed from SM 2.8; SM states no lookback rows, so every bucket row's fields are derived. Every credited second is level C and backfilled.
input_keys is false because the fixture has no presence sample at all. The Mac reports key presses (testdata/timelines/6.1 has idle_keys_s on every sample), but no sampler ran before pairtime did.
uncredited sums only the rows whose codes SM decides. agent_only_s is the agent's 2,250 s less the 25 s of PA credited inside each turn: 1,875. The open codes are the erratum's point 2.
Cycles 1 to 14 credit 120 s of reading each, 1,680 s in all, because each stop is followed by the next prompt 570 s later, inside SM 2.8's 600 s.
The live fixture credits 10,095 s of the same afternoon. Lookback keeps 5,055: no think leads, no editor, browser or commit time, no reading while the agent runs, at most 120 s of reading a turn.

The agent events replay to ai_logged_s 3930 under min(gap, 120 s) (SM 5.4), so DESIGN 6.2 D5 would let a program that opts in to level C count at most 1310 s of this, and only inside forge-verified commit intervals.
